name: twin-me-up
description: A personal work twin for every AI agent: your confirmed guidance and explicit grants, enforced.
long_description:
Twin Me Up gives every AI agent you use your confirmed guidance and your limits, and makes it ask before it acts.

- **Briefs** the agent on the guidance you have confirmed, red lines included.
- **Answers "am I allowed to do this?"** from explicit, expiring grants. Anything else returns ask.
- **Learns from your corrections** as lessons that only you can confirm.

**Before first use**, create your twin in a terminal: `uvx --from twin-me-up twinmeup init`. Teach it and review lessons with the `twinmeup` command; the passphrase you set there guards every human-only operation.

Local-first: your twin lives in `~/.twinmeup` on this machine. No telemetry.

tools.name: twin_brief
tools.description: Your confirmed guidance and current authority for a workflow. Call it at the start of work.

tools.name: twin_authorise
tools.description: May I do this now? Returns allow with the covering grant, or ask.

tools.name: twin_request_approval
tools.description: Ask your principal to approve one action. They decide in their own terminal.

tools.name: twin_approval_status
tools.description: Has the principal approved, declined or not yet decided, and is the approval still unused?

tools.name: twin_search
tools.description: Find confirmed guidance relevant to a question.

tools.name: twin_review_queue
tools.description: Unconfirmed lessons to show you for review.

tools.name: twin_track_record
tools.description: Evidence and stage for a workflow: learning, corrections, evaluations and grants.

tools.name: twin_next_questions
tools.description: The most valuable unanswered questions about a recorded decision.

tools.name: twin_record_decision
tools.description: Capture a real decision: situation, options, choice, reasons.

tools.name: twin_amend_decision
tools.description: Merge your answers to follow-up questions into a recorded decision.

tools.name: twin_record_correction
tools.description: Record when you edit, override or reject the agent's work.

tools.name: twin_propose_lesson
tools.description: Propose a lesson. It has no authority until you confirm it.
